description.en: The information about the CA certificate.

description.zh:
CA证书的地域。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~27584~~)接口查询地域ID。
description.en:
The region of the CA certificates.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~2401682~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 监听的标签键。N的取值范围：**1**~**20**。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。
description.en: The key of tag N. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
实例的标签值。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. Valid values of N: **1 to 20**. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.

descriptions.zh: 一次只能上传一份CA证书内容。添加成功后，返回该用户的该证书的ID、名称和指纹。
descriptions.en: You can upload only one CA certificate at a time. After a CA certificate is uploaded, the certificate ID, name, and fingerprint are returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb upload-ca-certificate --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=TestKey --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ca-certificate test --ca-certificate-name mycacert01 --resource-group-id rg-atst000000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun slb UploadCACertificate --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --ResourceGroupId 'rg-atst000000' --CACertificate test --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --CACertificateName mycacert01 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
